title: Food and Grocery (Mandatory) Code of Conduct Bill 2024
short_title: Food and Grocery (Mandatory) Code of Conduct Bill 2024

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would make the Food and Grocery Code of Conduct mandatory for large supermarkets and wholesalers with annual turnover over $5 billion.

It would introduce significant penalties for breaches, including fines of up to $2 million for infringement notices and penalties of three times the value of any benefit obtained from a contravention.
The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission would gain powers to audit retailers and wholesalers for compliance with the mandatory code.
changes: Makes the Food and Grocery Code of Conduct mandatory for large retailers and wholesalers with annual turnover over $5 billion.
Introduces significant penalties for breaches, including infringement notices of $2 million and penalties of three times the value of the benefit obtained from a contravention.
Gives the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission functions and powers to conduct audits of supermarket retailers and wholesalers.
summary.affected: Large retailers and wholesalers in the supermarket sector with annual turnover over $5 billion, and their suppliers.
